item.text:
observation low-a-successes
  quantity 81 successes measured

observation low-a-patients
  quantity 87 patients measured

observation low-b-successes
  quantity 234 successes measured

observation low-b-patients
  quantity 270 patients measured

observation high-a-successes
  quantity 192 successes measured

observation high-a-patients
  quantity 263 patients measured

observation high-b-successes
  quantity 55 successes measured

observation high-b-patients
  quantity 80 patients measured

claim low-a-rate
  = low-a-successes / low-a-patients

claim low-b-rate
  = low-b-successes / low-b-patients

claim high-a-rate
  = high-a-successes / high-a-patients

claim high-b-rate
  = high-b-successes / high-b-patients

link low-a-successes supports low-a-rate
link low-a-patients supports low-a-rate
link low-b-successes supports low-b-rate
link low-b-patients supports low-b-rate
link high-a-successes supports high-a-rate
link high-a-patients supports high-a-rate
link high-b-successes supports high-b-rate
link high-b-patients supports high-b-rate

claim a-better-low-risk
  Treatment A has a higher success rate than treatment B in the low-risk group.

link low-a-rate supports a-better-low-risk
link low-b-rate supports a-better-low-risk

claim a-better-high-risk
  Treatment A has a higher success rate than treatment B in the high-risk group.

link high-a-rate supports a-better-high-risk
link high-b-rate supports a-better-high-risk

claim pooled-a-successes
  = low-a-successes + high-a-successes

claim pooled-a-patients
  = low-a-patients + high-a-patients

claim pooled-b-successes
  = low-b-successes + high-b-successes

claim pooled-b-patients
  = low-b-patients + high-b-patients

link low-a-successes supports pooled-a-successes
link high-a-successes supports pooled-a-successes
link low-a-patients supports pooled-a-patients
link high-a-patients supports pooled-a-patients
link low-b-successes supports pooled-b-successes
link high-b-successes supports pooled-b-successes
link low-b-patients supports pooled-b-patients
link high-b-patients supports pooled-b-patients

claim pooled-a-rate
  = pooled-a-successes / pooled-a-patients

claim pooled-b-rate
  = pooled-b-successes / pooled-b-patients

link pooled-a-successes supports pooled-a-rate
link pooled-a-patients supports pooled-a-rate
link pooled-b-successes supports pooled-b-rate
link pooled-b-patients supports pooled-b-rate

claim b-better-overall
  Treatment B has a higher success rate after pooling both groups.

link pooled-a-rate supports b-better-overall
link pooled-b-rate supports b-better-overall

claim final-answer
  The answer is D.

link a-better-low-risk supports final-answer
link a-better-high-risk supports final-answer
link b-better-overall supports final-answer

model holds final-answer
  confidence 1 assumed
